unit.can_do_en: Can ask where something is and understand simple directions.

situation_en: In the same store, Omar asks Laura, who works there, where the coffee is and where the checkout is. Laura gives short, simple directions: the coffee is over there, on the shelf on the left, and after that Omar should go to the checkout, which is right here. Laura must tell him to go to the checkout in one sentence, using the to-form of the place (as in kassalle, hyllylle), and the checkout itself is right here. Omar checks that he understood, Laura says yes, and they both say thanks.

speakers.name: Laura
speakers.role_en: a staff member at the information desk

speakers.name: Omar
speakers.role_en: a customer who is new to this store
